All four equity fills landed 14:06-14:47 ET, inside US regular hours, at prices inside their 08-17 ranges; all five crypto fills sit inside Binance mainnet 1-minute ranges. No SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT. THE DAY'S DRIVER STORY: a macro shock the fleet was long in one place and short in another. Hormuz transits stopped, crude held above 82, the 30-year yield hit a 19-year high; commodity made 19.37 on it, allweather's TLT sleeve lost 3.35 to it, hunter rotated into silver on the back of it. 'hype_sentiment' took its three best lines in weeks (two lottery timer wins plus hypecrypto's first trade) and improved to 13/21, which means 'technical' is now the fleet's worst driver at 13/24 for the first time.

driver_note: Three things on the record. Hype improved today only because the lottery book's STALLED timer cut two positions that happened to be slightly up; that is the same rule that produced three losses yesterday by cutting positions that happened to be slightly down. One day of luck in a timer is not evidence about a strategy. SECOND, meanrev is logged 'unknown' for the second consecutive day. cross_book_observation: The fleet ran an accidental controlled experiment today. The paper bot hypecrypto and the real-money lottery book both bought GPS off the same Grok euphoria signal. hypecrypto filled at 0.01637 at 18:06Z on 08-17 and is +5.3%; lottery filled at 0.0174 at 04:24Z on 08-18, ten hours and 6.3% later, and is -0.92%. Same coin, same signal source, opposite results, and the entire difference is entry latency. The lottery book's own LATE guard had refused GPS two hours before it bought, on the grounds that the pump had already happened.
